qa_pairs.question: What type of high-performance network is used to connect all the nodes within the tamIA cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: All the nodes of the tamIA cluster are linked together by an InfiniBand NVIDIA NDR network.

qa_pairs.question: Could you describe the specifications of the nodes in the tamIA cluster that are equipped with NVIDIA HGX H200 GPUs?
qa_pairs.answer: The tamIA cluster has 12 nodes equipped with 8 NVIDIA HGX H200 SXM 141GB HBM3 GPUs each. These nodes also feature 64 cores, 1024GB of available memory, two Intel Xeon Gold 6448Y 2.1 GHz (32C) CPUs, and one 7.68TB SSD for storage.

qa_pairs.question: What are the main characteristics of the tamIA cluster nodes that utilize NVIDIA HGX H100 GPUs?
qa_pairs.answer: The tamIA cluster includes 53 nodes with 4 NVIDIA HGX H100 SXM 80GB HBM3 GPUs each. These nodes also have 48 cores, 512GB of available memory, two Intel Xeon Gold 6442Y 2.6 GHz (24C) CPUs, and a 7.68TB SSD for storage.
